title: Quarterly Theme-to-Initiative Mapping and Cross-Org Commitment Plan
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Create an auditable, stakeholder-agreed mapping from company-level themes (Quarterly Themes + OKRs) to concrete initiatives owned by PM, Eng, Design and Research. Deliverables: 1) canonical initiative registry (spreadsheet + console view) that ties each initiative to an OKR and success metric, 2) resourcing and dependency plan with committed owners, and 3) launch/cadence plan for cross-org weekly syncs and exec readouts. Rationale: Previous cycles showed ambiguous ownership between Platform and Infra on two high-risk initiatives; this caused missed rollout windows and surfaced inconsistent success metrics. This ticket codifies a lightweight, repeatable alignment process ahead of the mid-Q planning window.
acceptance_criteria: All company-level OKRs have at least one linked initiative with an owner and estimate
Dependencies documented for >90% of initiatives (engineering, infra, security, legal)
Executive alignment session completed with sign-offs from CEO, VP Product, VP Eng, VP Design
Registry published to shared Drive and linked in the Roadmap Console
Weekly cross-functional sync cadence and agenda template published
success_metrics: Reduction in cross-team blockers reported in roadmap retro by 50% vs previous quarter
On-time delivery rate for company-prioritized initiatives improvement target: +15%
plan: Phase 1 (weeks 1-2): intake and whiteboarding with PM leads + executive sponsors; produce draft mapping. Phase 2 (weeks 3-4): working sessions with Eng/Design/Research to validate estimates, risks, and dependencies; lock owners. Phase 3 (week 5): exec readout and sign-off; publish canonical registry and schedule weekly syncs. Phase 4 (post-sign-off): monitor, iterate on cadence and tooling (Roadmap Console changes) and collect first retro at end of Q1.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Ambiguous ownership where multiple teams claim partial responsibility -> Mitigation: require a single accountable owner per initiative and list collaborating teams
Risk: Underestimated engineering effort -> Mitigation: Eng leads to provide best-effort sizing and flag >30% uncertainty items for contingency
Risk: Exec bandwidth for sign-off delays cadence -> Mitigation: pre-read one week before exec session and escalate through VP sponsors
